A) The visual hierarchy was confusing because the price for the "Wireless Mouse" ($39.99) is displayed in a larger, bolder font than the final "Total" amount.
B) The layout lacked clear separation between individual item prices and the summary calculations (Subtotal/Shipping), causing all the numbers to compete for attention.
C) The label "Total" was not distinct enough from the other line items above it, making it difficult to identify which row represented the final sum.
D) None of the above — but only if A, B, and C genuinely miss what you meant (you must still name the specific element you were referring to)
